saved mask comes from C20: the full 60x60 region is loaded, sea cells are defined from target-period finiteness, per-doy Hazen 90th-percentile thresholds are built from ±5-day pools covering 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05, and these are smoothed with a dense 366x366 matrix product (so every raw threshold day enters each smoothed value). Target-day SSTs (2007-06-01 to 2007-08-31) are then compared to the smoothed thresholds, runs are found and joined, and in_mhw is written to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
